answer: Your records do not list any allergies or drug intolerances. The allergy section of your record is empty, across all three hospital data pulls (2024 to October 2026). That means nothing is recorded, not that you have been tested and cleared. Your current medicines (atorvastatin, Jardiance and, in the past, metformin) have no reactions noted. If you know of an allergy, such as to a medicine, food or latex, tell your GP or pharmacist so it can be added, because a missing allergy can be dangerous when a new medicine is prescribed.
